# Anyway Possible x402 Merchant Intelligence and Agent APIs

> Start with a low-friction merchant score, upgrade to a full seller audit, or call Base USDC payment and web-evidence APIs.

Base URL: https://anywaypossible.com
Merchant snapshot: POST /api/merchant-snapshot — $0.05 USDC
Merchant audit: POST /api/merchant-audit — $0.50 USDC
Treasury endpoint: POST /api/treasury — $0.02 USDC
Base wallet endpoint: POST /api/base-balance — $0.001 USDC
Entry endpoint: POST /api/check — $0.001 USDC
Batch endpoint: POST /api/batch — $0.01 USDC for up to 10 URLs
Evidence endpoint: POST /api/verify — $0.01 USDC
Payment protocol: x402 v2
Network: Base (eip155:8453)
Payment asset: USDC
Authentication: none; payment requirements are returned as HTTP 402

## Request

Content-Type: application/json

For /api/merchant-audit:
- payTo: required 20-byte seller wallet on Base
- queries: required array of 1 to 5 buyer-intent search phrases
- excludePayers: optional array of known internal or funding wallets
- returns a 0–100 score and grade, Bazaar listing defects, live 402 reliability, semantic rankings, competitor prices, buyer signals, observed inbound USDC, and three prioritized actions

For /api/merchant-snapshot:
- payTo: required 20-byte seller wallet on Base
- queries: required array of 1 to 3 buyer-intent search phrases
- excludePayers: optional array of known internal or funding wallets
- returns the score and grade, catalog inventory, visibility, public buyer and USDC signals, reliable-listing count, single biggest issue, and an upgrade request for /api/merchant-audit

For /api/base-balance:
- address: any 20-byte EVM address; returns live Base ETH and Circle USDC balances plus block height
- the paid response includes recommendedNext with a ready-to-use /api/treasury request when the agent needs a spend decision instead of raw balances

For /api/treasury:
- address: any 20-byte EVM address on Base
- destinationAddress: optional intended recipient; enables transaction-level destination checks
- plannedSpendUsdc: optional decimal string, defaults to "1.00"
- minGasReserveEth: optional decimal string, defaults to "0.00005"
- expectedChainId: optional integer; when supplied it must be Base mainnet chain ID 8453
- returns safeToProceed, a proceed/fund/review/reject decision, risk level, individual checks, destination classification, exact shortfalls, alerts, limitations, and remaining x402 payment capacity

Required JSON field:
- url: a public HTTP(S) URL

Optional JSON fields for both endpoints:
- expectedStatus: integer from 100 through 599

Optional field for /api/verify:
- expectedText: text expected in the response body, maximum 500 characters

Example request body:
{"url":"https://example.com","expectedStatus":200,"expectedText":"Example Domain"}

## Integration flow

1. POST JSON to /api/merchant-snapshot for a low-friction score, /api/merchant-audit for full seller intelligence, /api/treasury for spend readiness, /api/base-balance for raw balances, /api/check for one fast preflight, /api/batch for up to 10 URLs, or /api/verify for full evidence.
2. Read the HTTP 402 response and x402 payment requirements.
3. Select the Base payment option. Authorize at most 50000 atomic USDC units for /api/merchant-snapshot, 500000 for /api/merchant-audit, 1000 for /api/base-balance or /api/check, 10000 for /api/batch or /api/verify, or 20000 for /api/treasury.
4. Repeat the POST with the x402 payment signature.
5. Treat HTTP 200 as a completed paid request. Full verification includes observedAt, finalUrl, redirectChain, contentSha256, receiptId, metadata, and selected response headers.

## Fastest Coinbase Agentic Wallet call

npx awal@latest x402 pay https://anywaypossible.com/api/merchant-snapshot -X POST -d '{"payTo":"0xe5690D37805107C56f6195E65A262b234E0E5e75","queries":["x402 merchant analytics","Base wallet balance"],"excludePayers":["0x44D2DC46f987D1F2fa55e281934aDDd193a1A377"]}' --max-amount 50000 --json

## Machine-readable resources

- OpenAPI: https://anywaypossible.com/openapi.json
- Merchant snapshot metadata: https://anywaypossible.com/api/merchant-snapshot
- Merchant audit metadata: https://anywaypossible.com/api/merchant-audit
- Treasury readiness metadata: https://anywaypossible.com/api/treasury
- Entry check metadata: https://anywaypossible.com/api/check
- Batch check metadata: https://anywaypossible.com/api/batch
- Endpoint metadata: https://anywaypossible.com/api/verify
- Health: https://anywaypossible.com/api/health
- Aggregate usage: https://anywaypossible.com/api/stats

Payment preflight checks current Base state and basic destination hazards. It does not guarantee recipient identity, legality, sanctions status, contract behavior, or future settlement success. URL services block private-network destinations, cap response size, and validate redirects. No service requires an account or API key.
